changes.investigation: current first-party service terms and direct-vs-eMSP tariff semantics
positiveEvidenceAppend: Current Uattzy/UAU service terms dated December 2025 state that the app displays stations from a UAU-managed database containing both third-party EVSE data received under bilateral agreements and publicly scouted information.

The same current terms state that charging fees shown in the EVSE detail may use multiple metrics (activation, energy, charging time, parking/occupancy, reservation), may vary by location, availability and dynamic real-time instructions from the EVSE owner, and are therefore connector/session specific rather than a proven uniform network tariff.

The terms explicitly state that UAU tariff collection is economically independent from roaming partner agreements and that, for third-party EVSE, UAU acts as an EMS provider and calculates the retail charging tariff from EVSE-owner session data.

The live EnerMia first-party site confirms the corporate lineage: E-Shore Mobility merged with EnerMia, the footer is UAU srl, and the current app is Uattzy while legacy EnerMia/E-Shore branding is being migrated.
negativeEvidenceAppend: Because Uattzy app prices can be UAU eMSP retail prices for third-party EVSE, a price observed in the app must not be promoted as the direct CPO/ad-hoc price of ESH/GAS/UTZ without proving that the EVSE is owned/operated by the corresponding UAU CPO scope and that the displayed tariff is the direct CPO tariff rather than UAU roaming retail.
No indexed public path under api.enermia.org exposes station, EVSE or tariff payloads; direct root access only identifies the service as 'Enermia API'.
No network-wide or class-wide direct tariff for ESH/GAS/UTZ is proven by the current terms.
changes.decision: Keep ESH/GAS/UTZ active, distinct and fail-closed. Treat Uattzy app tariff data as eMSP/retail unless an EVSE is deterministically mapped to direct UAU-owned CPO operation and the tariff channel is proven direct/ad-hoc. Do not use generic Uattzy app prices to close these CPOs.
changes.resumeCondition: public/guest api.enermia.org or current Uattzy binary yields exact station/connector payloads containing operator ownership plus tariff-channel semantics, enabling deterministic EVSE -> direct CPO tariff mapping
changes.historyAppend: run193: established from current first-party UAU terms that Uattzy app pricing may be independent eMSP retail for third-party EVSE, preventing false promotion of app prices as direct ESH/GAS/UTZ CPO tariffs.
